items.question: What qualifications do I need to enroll?
items.answer: Our programs are designed for MBBS, BDS, BPT, BA & BSc, BAMS, BHMS and other health sciences students. No prior industry experience is required — just a willingness to learn and build real projects.

items.question: Are the classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Most programs combine scheduled live sessions with clinician mentors and recorded lectures you can rewatch anytime. Some programs are fully self-paced. Check the program detail page for the exact format.

items.question: Is the certificate recognised by employers?
items.answer: Yes. Every StimuliiQ certificate is digitally verifiable. An employer can scan its QR code or enter the certificate ID on our verification page to confirm it instantly.

items.question: What are the payment options?
items.answer: We accept all major payment methods via Razorpay: UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and wallets. Coupon codes can be applied at checkout for additional discounts.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: Our courses are crafted with care and commitment, and as such, we do not offer refunds. We believe in the value and quality of our educational services!

data.heading: Not sure which internship is right for you?
